content: Is menge Anak ni Israel
Iyan heini sikandan menge anak ni Israel he menge maama: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Juda, Isacar, Zebulun,
Dan, Jose, Benjamin, Naftali, Gad, wey Asher.
Is menge Kevuwazan ni Juda

Duen tetelu he anak ni Juda he menge maama ziyà te esawa zin he si Batshua he Canaanhen. Si Er, Oran, wey si Shela. Si Er, ne iyan kinekekayan. Kenà meupiya is ulaula zin diyà te etuvangan te Nengazen, umbe midhimetayan sikandin te Nengazen.
Duen pa anak ni Juda he menge maama ziyà te ambey zin he si Tamar. He iyan si Perez wey si Zera. Lelima langun is anak ni Juda he menge maama.
Is menge maama he anak ni Perez ne iyan si Hezron wey si Hamul.
Is menge anak ni Zera he menge maama, ne iyan si Zimri, Etan, Heman, Calcol, wey Darda–lelima sikandan langun.
Is anak ni Carmi he maama ne si Acar. Iyan heini si Acar kes mid-uwit te kezeetan te Israel tenged te kegkuwaa zin duen te vutang ne imbeǥey en diyà te Megbevayà.
Is anak ni Etan he maama ne si Azaria.
Ebpuun te Apù ni Juda he si Hezron Pehendiyà te ki David
Is menge anak ni Hezron he menge maama, ne iyan si Jerameel, Ram, wey Caleb.
Si Ram, ne amey ni Aminadab, ne si Aminadab, ne amey ni Nashon he pengulu te Juda.
Si Nashon, ne amey ni Salmon, ne si Salmon, ne amey ni Boaz.
Si Boaz, ne amey ni Obed, ne si Obed, ne amey ni Jesse.
Ne iyan kinekekayan he anak ni Jesse, si Eliab, is ikezuwa, iyan si Abinadab, is iketelu, iyan si Shimea,
is ikeepat, iyan si Natanel, is ikelima, iyan si Radai,
is ikeenem, iyan si Ozem, ne is ikepitu, iyan si David.
Ne iyan menge suled dan he menge vahi si Zeruya wey si Abigail. Si Zeruya ne zuen tetelu he anak din he menge maama he si Abishai, Joab, wey Asahel.
Ne iyan nekeesawa ki Abigail, si Jeter he Ismailihanen ne zuen dan anak he maama he si Amasa.
Is menge Kevuwazan ni Caleb he Anak ni Hezron
Si Caleb he anak ni Hezron, duen menge anak din diyà te esawa zin he si Azuba he egngezanan daan ki Jeriot. Ne iyan heini menge anak ni Jeriot: si Jesher, Shobab, wey Ardon.
Hein minatey si Azuba ne mid-esawa ni Caleb si Efrat ne mid-anak dan ne iyan si Hur.
Si Hur, ne amey ni Uri, ne si Uri, ne amey ni Bezalel.
Ne hein 60 en is penuiǥen ni Hezron, ne nengesawa sikandin te anak ni Makir, te suled ni Gilead he vahi. Duen dan anak he si Segub.
Si Segub amey ni Jair, he iyan midumala te 23 he inged diyà te Gilead.
(Piru mid-aǥew ni Geshur wey ni Aram haazà is menge inged ni Jair apil is Kenat, wey menge inged he nekelingut kayi. 60 langun he lugar.) Pudu heini menge kevuwazan ni Makir he amey ni Gilead.
Wazà meuǥet ne minatey si Hezron diyà te Caleb Efrata hein mid-anak is esawa zin he si Abia. Is anak dan ne si Ashur he amey ni Tekoa.
Is menge Kevuwazan ni Hezron diyà te ki Jerameel
Si Jerameel, is penganey ni Hezron, lelima is menge anak din he maama. Si Ram is kinekekayan, is menge sunud, ne si Buna, si Oren, si Ozem, wey si Ahia.
Si Jerameel ne zuen sevaha pa he esawa zin he egngezanan ki Atara. Ne si Atara, iyan iney ni Onam.
Is menge anak ni Ram he menge maama te kinekekayan ni Jerameel, ne iyan si Maaz, Jamin, wey Eker.
Is menge anak ni Onam he menge maama iyan si Shamai wey si Jada. Ne is menge anak ni Shamai he menge maama ne si Nadab wey si Abishur.
Iyan ngazan te esawa ni Abishur si Abihail. Duen menge anak dan he menge maama he iyan si Aban wey si Molid.
Is menge anak ni Nadab he menge maama iyan si Seled wey si Apaim. Minatey si Seled he wazè en mekaanak.
Is anak ni Apaim he maama, ne iyan si Ishi. Si Ishi ne amey ni Sheshan, ne si Sheshan amey ni Alai.
Si Jada is suled ni Shamai, dezuwa is menge anak din he maama he iyan si Jeter wey si Jonatan. Minatey si Jeter he wazè en mekaanak.
Is menge anak ni Jonatan he menge maama, ne iyan si Pelet wey Zaza. Iyan heini sikandan menge kevuwazan ni Jerameel.
Si Sheshan, ne wazè din anak he menge maama; menge vahi zà. Duen suluǥuen din he Ehiptohanen he egngezanan ki Jarha.
Impeesawa ni Sheshan ki Jarha is sevaha te menge anak din he vahi, ne mid-anak sikandan te maama ne iyan ngazan din si Atai.
Si Atai ne amey ni Natan, si Natan amey ni Zabad,
ne si Zabad amey ni Eflal. Si Eflal amey ni Obed,
si Obed amey ni Jehu, ne si Jehu amey ni Azaria.
Si Azaria amey ni Helez, si Helez amey ni Eleasa,
ne si Eleasa amey ni Sismai. Si Sismai amey ni Shalum,
si Shalum amey ni Jekamia, ne si Jekamia amey ni Elishama.
Is Duma pa he menge Kevuwazan ni Hezron diyà te ki Caleb
Is kinekekayan he anak ni Caleb he maama te suled ni Jerameel, ne iyan si Mesha he amey ni Zif. Ne is ikezuwa he anak din, ne si Maresha he amey ni Hebron.
Is menge anak ni Hebron he menge maama, ne iyan si Kora, Tapua, Rekem, wey si Shema.
Si Shema amey ni Raham, ne si Raham amey ni Jorkeam. Si Rekem amey ni Shamai,
si Shamai amey ni Maon, ne si Maon amey ni Bet Zur.
Is sevaha pa he esawa ni Caleb ne iyan si Efa he iney ni Haran, Moza, wey Gazez. Si Haran, ne zuen din anak he egngezanan daan ki Gazez.
Is menge anak ni Jahdai he menge maama, ne iyan si Regem, Jotam, Geshan, Pelet, Efa, wey Shaaf.
Ne is sevaha pa maan he esawa ni Caleb, ne iyan si Maaca. Duen menge anak dan he menge maama he iyan si Sheber, Tirhana,
Shaaf (he amey ni Madmana), wey Sheva (he amey ni Macbena wey ni Gibea). Is anak ni Caleb he vahi ne iyan si Acsa.

Iyan heini sikandan menge kevuwazan ni Caleb. Is menge Kevuwazan te Anak ni Caleb he si Hur Iyan si Hur kinekekayan he anak ni Caleb wey ni Efrata. Is menge anak ni Hur he menge maama, ne iyan si Shobal he amey ni Kiriat Jearim,
si Salma he amey ni Betlehem, wey si Haref he amey ni Bet Gader.
Is menge kevuwazan ni Shobal he amey ni Kiriat Jearim he iyan menge meǥinged te Haroe, is ketengà te menge etew he ed-ubpà diyà te Menuhot,
wey is menge kezuzumahi ni Kiriat Jearim ne iyan is Itranen, Puthanen, Shumatnen, wey Mishranen. Iyan heini mibpuunan te menge Zoratnen, wey Eshtaulinen.
Is menge kevuwazan ni Salma, ne iyan is menge tig-Betlehem, is menge tig-Netofa, is menge tig-Atrot Bet Joab, is ketengà te Manahatnen, is menge Zurhanen,

wey menge pemilya te utew memetau he edsurat te menge dukumintu he ziyà ed-ubpà te inged he Jabez he iyan is menge Tiratnen, menge Simiyatnen, wey menge Sucatnen. Iyan heini sikandan menge Kinhanen he ebpuun ki Hammat, he iyan midtukud te Bet Recab.
